chronicle: Bo settled down and founded the village.
Ada worked out how to keep a fire.
The village began building a fire pit.
The fire pit was finished and the fire lit.
Jory worked out how to lay a road.
Jory worked out how to knap stone into tools.
Tam worked out how to store food and goods for everyone.
The village began building a storehouse.
Linnet worked out how to plant and tend crops.
Pip worked out how to build with stone.
Perch worked out how to raise a monument.
The village began raising a monument.
The first tier of the monument was laid.
